name: Apollo Portal Console
description: Preview: manage Apollo 2.x configuration with independently authored pages and password login. Full 1:1 parity is incomplete.
releaseNotes: 0.1.3-rc.2 Preview: success notices auto-dismiss after 5 seconds without resetting editors; stale feedback clears before new actions. Independently authored header autocomplete supports app/Key targets, retained-view normalization and multi-environment pagination. Source-measured menus, compact cluster rows and configuration table previews/badges/actions are repaired. Ten focused native DBX0.6.49 checks pass against real local Apollo2.5.2. Full all-page/all-dialog 1:1 remains FAIL. Author packages are unsigned candidates; official Store review/signing remains required.

zh-CN.name: Apollo Portal 控制台
zh-CN.description: 预览版：独立编写 Apollo 2.x 管理页面，支持普通账号密码登录。全量页面及弹窗 1:1 对照尚未通过。
